subject: QBR prep: runway stitch + per-account one-pagers
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: QBR prep: runway stitch + per-account one-pagers

Team — kicking off a short prep thread for next week's QBR. Goal: get a consolidated forecast + a one-page summary for each of the top 12 enterprise accounts we’ll present. I want this to be lightweight and usable in the exec deck; focus on "status, runway (in months), top risks, next ask".

Quick asks: 
- Rishi: please run the consolidated forecast (attach the stitched CSV) and include a confidence column (high/med/low) per account. I pasted a small sample in Drive for format.
- Marissa: can you produce one-paragraph account summaries for the 12 accounts (highlighting buying committee, blockers, and POC on our side)? Use the attached PDF template.
- Karthik: I need a 2-slide readiness check for the deck (canary accounts, risk waterfall, and recommended mitigations).

Deliverables and deadlines: 
- Forecast CSV + confidence: EOD Wednesday (2027-04-21 17:00 PT)
- Account one-pagers (PDF pages or doc): Thursday noon PT (2027-04-22 12:00 PT)
- Readiness slides: Thursday EOD (2027-04-22 17:00 PT)

Attachments: [Attachment: 2027_QBR_account_onepagers.pdf (pdf, 1.1MB)], [Attachment: forecast_stitch_template.csv (csv, 20KB)]

Link to workspace: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBqQBR-Prep-Runway

Notes on prioritization: prioritize accounts with >$250k ACV first and any renewal within 90 days. If you hit an open security/compliance question (SOC2, data residency) mark as high-risk and loop in Legal/Trust.

Thanks — Vanessa
Vanessa Ortiz | Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 09:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: QBR prep: runway stitch + per-account one-pagers

Thanks — on it. Quick status: I pulled the latest bookings and ARR tags this morning and started the forecast stitch. Early observations: Acme Analytics and CloudCorp are both above the $250k threshold but show different risk profiles (Acme: legal procurement lag; CloudCorp: integration readiness).

I uploaded a working CSV: forecast_stitch_v3.csv (in the Drive folder). Columns: account, region, rep, ACV, forecast_stage, confidence (high/med/low), expected_close, runway_months, notes.

A couple of asks for accuracy: 
- Marissa: can you confirm POC emails and the single strongest risk sentence for each account so I can populate notes?
- Vanessa: should I apply a conservative uplift/discount for accounts flagged as "integration risk"? My inclination is -15% on probability weight for medium confidence accounts.

I'll plan to finalize v4 by EOD Wednesday and export a short summary tab for the exec deck.

— Rishi
Rishi Malhotra | VP Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>

Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: QBR prep: runway stitch + per-account one-pagers

Adding the one-pagers as I finish them — attaching three drafts for review (Acme, BrightLine, CloudCorp). Using the template Van shared. Highlights: 

- Acme Analytics: PO (Data Platform) is enthusiastic; Procurement has requested a copy of our data handling matrix and a 3rd-party security attestation. Risk: procurement timeline (60–90 days). Ask: expedite SOC2 evidence and offer a 30-day pilot contract to reduce spend friction.
- BrightLine (mid-market but strategic): Ahead of renewal; low risk, rep has commitment to a payment plan. Ask: push for formalized SSO integration schedule to close by EOM.
- CloudCorp: Integration technical spike required; legal needs clause edits around customer-managed keys. Risk: integration could push close beyond Q3. Ask: propose a 6-week dedicated onboarding slot from our Professional Services.

Attachment stubs: [Attachment: ACME_onepager_draft.pdf (pdf, 120KB)], [Attachment: BrightLine_onepager_draft.pdf (pdf, 80KB)], [Attachment: CloudCorp_onepager_draft.pdf (pdf, 140KB)]

I'll continue with the remaining nine. If you want me to prioritize any specific account, flag and I'll move it up.

— Marissa
Marissa Cole | Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai | x423

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: QBR prep: runway stitch + per-account one-pagers

Perfect — this is exactly the cadence I wanted. Quick replies inline: 
- Rishi: apply -15% on medium-confidence integration risk accounts and call out a separate "legal hold" flag for procurement redlines; good plan on the summary tab.
- Marissa: prioritize CloudCorp and Acme (they're the two largest at-risk dollars), then the three renewals due in the next 60 days. Great job on the drafts. 
- Karthik: when you have slides ready, drop them in the Drive folder and I'll add notes for the exec readout.

Final note for the group: if any account requires an executive call (CRO/CXO level), flag here and I’ll coordinate schedules with the prospect. Otherwise, keep the one-pagers focused and short.

I'll consolidate everything into a single PDF for the QBR deck on Friday morning and share the final link. Thanks all — Vanessa
